g.text: Blue: components of the Reporting module. Grey: other modules of the same application (ADR-0002).
Removed from the earlier design: Automation Mode Planner (full-auto dropped, ADR-0001; automation is
per-value provenance), KPI Engine (KPI computation is owned by the KPI module), Template Mapper (report
resources use the template pack IDs directly), Event Publisher (no event bus, ADR-0002).
